topic: Anthropic mathematician claims AI-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis
title: Anthropic Researcher Claims AI-Assisted Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
dek: Levent Alpöge used Claude AI to develop a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis over six weeks, later verified in the Lean proof assistant.
body:
Levent Alpöge, a researcher at Anthropic, announced on November 20, 2026, a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis developed with assistance from the Claude AI system. The hypothesis, first posed in 1859, addresses the distribution of prime numbers across the integers. Primes serve as the basic building blocks of whole numbers, yet their spacing has resisted simple description for more than a century and a half.

The work took roughly six weeks and extended to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis as well. Alpöge stated that Claude played a key role near the end of the process. The proof was then written in the Lean proof assistant, a formal language designed to allow computers to check mathematical arguments step by step.

## Verification Steps

Independent groups examined the Lean code and confirmed it was correct on November 21. This formal check is a necessary first filter, but it does not replace the broader review that mathematicians perform when reading a human-readable argument. The full paper in ordinary mathematical language has not yet been released.

Anthropic had listed its shares on Nasdaq a short time before the announcement. The company has been involved in other AI-assisted mathematical work during 2026, though none previously reached this level of claimed significance.

## Community Review Ahead

If the claim withstands scrutiny, it would mark a major advance in number theory. Mathematicians will now examine the human-readable version once it appears, checking both the logical steps and any new techniques introduced. Such review can take months or longer, even when formal verification has already occurred.

The outcome remains uncertain until that wider examination finishes. Earlier AI-assisted results in mathematics have required similar periods of careful study before gaining full acceptance.
